market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham is a financially stable mid-table Premier League club with no recent history of relegation battles. Even considering the long time horizon to 2025-26, a 34.5% implied probability is unrealistically high relative to their squad strength and resources. A more accurate relegation probability is around 10%.
evidence_points: West Ham finished 9th in 2023-24, 14th in 2022-23, 7th in 2021-22, and 6th in 2020-21, showing consistent upper-half or mid-table performance.
The club has significant revenue, London-based stadium, and stable ownership, all reducing the risk of a sudden collapse.
Historical Premier League data shows that established mid-table clubs are relegated far less frequently than the 15% average, typically well below 10% per season.
